# ipforge_subnet_pool (Data Source)

Look up an allocation pool by subnet and name, including its current utilization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check how much room a pool has left before allocating from it.
data "ipforge_subnet_pool" "linux" {
  subnet_id = 3
  name      = "linux"
}

output "linux_pool_free" {
  value = data.ipforge_subnet_pool.linux.free
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `subnet_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `end_ip` (String)
- `free` (Number) Addresses still available to allocate.
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `reserved` (Number) Addresses blocked by reserved ranges (gateway, exclusions).
- `start_ip` (String)
- `total` (Number) Addresses in the pool.
- `used` (Number) Addresses in use (assigned, reserved status, discovered, deprecated).
